QuestInfo.name: Shumi's Request
QuestInfo.1: I got a second request from #p406#. #p403#, who usually hangs out in front of the subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she just got from a friend. I need to defeat #b25 #o11#s#k and bring #b15 #t4000011#s#k to #b#p406##k for the dog house.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered what #p403# asked for and got a bunch of #t2020002#s in return. Now, #p403#'s little puppy has his own house. Return to #p406# for another gig.

0.0: You're here. Great. I have another gig for you. #b#p403##k, sitting in front of the subway station, needs help. A friend of hers gave her a puppy as a present a few days ago, and she's looking to make a cute, comfortable doghouse for him.
0.1: I think I just need you to defeat #r25 #o11#s#k and bring #b15 #t4000011#s#k. It'll be a breeze for someone like you, so please don't make that poor puppy wait out in the cold any longer than he has to! Come back to me as soon as you have them--I'll be waiting.

1.0: I like you. You know how to take care of business. All right, here's your reward. #b#p403##k is giving you a bunch of homemade #b#t2020002#s#k.

yes.0: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see that you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p403##k requested. She needs #b15 #t4000011#s#k to build a house for the puppy. When you've defeated #b25 #o11#s#k and gathered the #t4000011#s, bring them all to me. Good luck!
